mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalMeetingCount, ROUND(AVG(duration),1) AS avgMeetingDuration, COUNT(CASE WHEN media_type = 1 THEN 1 END) AS videoMeetingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN media_type = 3 THEN 1 END) AS localMeetingCount FROM bbx_third_meeting_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 1
SELECT room_name AS roomName, COUNT(*) AS useCount FROM bbx_third_meeting_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 1 GROUP BY room_name ORDER BY useCount ${sortOrder} LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN duration <= 1 THEN 1 END) AS r1, COUNT(CASE WHEN duration > 1 AND duration <= 2 THEN 1 END) AS r2, COUNT(CASE WHEN duration > 2 AND duration <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS r3, COUNT(CASE WHEN duration > 3 THEN 1 END) AS r4 FROM bbx_third_meeting_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 1
SELECT department_name deptName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM bbx_third_meeting_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 1 GROUP BY deptName ORDER BY count DESC
